source_notes.label: Keep three time statements separate
source_notes.summary: The detailed procedure calls for a further 4 h at room temperature. Scheme 1 and Figures1–5 identify2 h preparations, while the discussion mentions20 min. Their sample relationship is unresolved; the4 h example is not silently assigned the2 h TEM image.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2–3, Experimental Section, Scheme1, Figures1–5 and Results

source_notes.label: Source ligand-size statements conflict
source_notes.summary: The explicit Brus-model diameters are3.88 nm for ME/Cd2+=0.5,4.34 nm for 1 and 5.02 nm for 2. The text also says increasing ligand decreases size and blue-shifts absorption. Both are retained without reversing sample labels. The peak list396 nm (3.13 eV),400 nm (3.10 eV),410 nm (3.03 eV) is retained at series scope because its ordering and trend cannot safely repair that conflict.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2–3, Figure1 and ligand-ratio discussion

source_notes.label: Solvent and ligand series are not a specimen crosswalk
source_notes.summary: The solvent-series ratios H2O/DMF=0.2,0.45 and 0.9 by mass have peaks377,388 and 400 nm and author-model diameters3.71,3.98 and 4.34 nm, respectively. Their ME amount is unspecified. Do not merge the0.2 solvent-series specimen with the2/1 ME specimen solely from matching solvent ratio. Precipitation above a1.5 mass ratio is qualitative.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 3, Figure3 and solvent discussion

source_notes.label: Phase, TEM and model estimates have different scopes
source_notes.summary: Figure 2 shows the2 h ME/Cd2+/S2−=2/1/0.67 specimen with about 5 nm mean TEM size. Figure 4 compares with-ME and no-ME2 h specimens and attributes overlapping peaks to cubic and hexagonal CdS; no exact phase fraction or refined unit cell is supplied. UV-derived sizes are model estimates, not TEM measurements.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 3, Figures2–4 and corresponding discussion

source_notes.label: Ligand binding and TGA labels
source_notes.summary: The authors infer robust ME–CdS bonding from FT-IR and TGA. They report decomposition beginning near 220 °C, pure-ME boiling point157 °C, about 25 wt% organic ME and an ambiguous statement about 95 wt% of sample beginning to decompose. Figure 5 caption says(a) without ME,(b) with ME; the body reverses those letters. Keep the numeric prose at source-context scope instead of treating95% as a measured loss or using the swapped labels.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 3–4, Figure5 and TGA discussion

source_notes.label: Two steps graft polyurethane
source_notes.summary: Hydroxyl-coated CdS is reacted with TDI at 85 °C for 3 h under nitrogen. BG/PPG in DMF and catalyst are added dropwise at 85 °C. This stage lasts 0.5 h; the addition duration is not separately reported. It is followed by 90 °C for 4 h. The overall BG:PPG:TDI ratio is 1:1:1.6. Absolute charges, the 50 wt% DMF denominator and film formation are unresolved. FT-IR supports NCO-bearing intermediates, not a measured single molecular geometry.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2, 4, Polymer synthesis, Scheme1 and Figure6

source_notes.label: Optical hybrid results are qualified
source_notes.summary: The 1.5 and 3.0 wt% CdS hybrids have absorption near 400 nm. In the Figure 7 discussion, the authors interpret this as unchanged CdS size of about 5 nm; it is not a hybrid TEM measurement. The Figure 8 discussion attributes broader hybrid PL tentatively to possible changes in CdS surface structure and particle size. These are distinct source-attributed interpretations, not resolved measurements. CdS suspension has approximate 425 and 600 nm bands with 325 nm excitation; the 1.5 wt% hybrid film has stronger, broader emission. No graph-only intensities, linewidths or quantum yields are extracted.
